aboutPage.metaDescription: Alphalize helps businesses turn manual processes into automated workflows — ERP implementation, business intelligence and custom software, from Kollam, Kerala.
aboutPage.title: We help implement your ideas into [[automation]]
aboutPage.lead: We understand the power of automation in streamlining business processes and unlocking operational efficiency — and we are more interested in what it changes for you than in the technology itself.
aboutPage.para1: At Alphalize, we understand the power of automation in streamlining business processes and unlocking operational efficiency. We are passionate about helping our clients bring their ideas to life and transforming manual tasks into automated workflows. Whether you have a specific automation concept in mind or need guidance in identifying opportunities for automation, our team of experts is here to guide you through the implementation process.
aboutPage.para2: We believe that successful automation begins with a clear understanding of your vision. Our team takes the time to listen and comprehend your ideas, goals and pain points. We collaborate closely with you to gain insight into your existing processes, identify areas that can benefit from automation, and tailor solutions that align with your vision.
aboutPage.para3: We combine your expertise in your industry with our technical proficiency to create automation solutions that drive tangible results — because the person who knows where the time is being lost is usually already inside your business.
aboutPage.supportNote: Support runs around the clock from Kollam, so there is cover well outside the hours the work itself happens in.

ceoPage.portraitAlt: Shan Sahib, Managing Director of Alphalize Technologies
ceoPage.intro1: Shan Sahib leads Alphalize Technologies from Kollam, Kerala. His focus is automation people can actually run: Odoo-based ERP built around how a shop, showroom or restaurant works day to day, the business intelligence that makes those numbers legible, and the custom software and IoT work that closes the gaps between them.
ceoPage.intro2: Under his direction the company joined the Odoo Partnership Program and opened a new development office in 2025, and in February 2026 his work in robotics service was recognised at the Insight Kerala Business Awards.
ceoPage.awardBody: Presented to Shan Sahib at BizConnect 2026 as part of the Insight Kerala Business Awards 2026 by Business Insight magazine — recognition for dependable robotics deployments and the long-term support that keeps them running.
